# BotanicExtract

> Supplier of specification-controlled botanical extracts and peptide ingredients from Xi'an, Shaanxi, China. Export brand of Xi'an Yuanqingyuan Technology Co., Ltd. Authorised export sales representative working with GMP-audited extraction facilities. Serves the U.S. dietary supplement and natural health market with batch-specific COA documentation, HPLC testing, OEM and private-label support.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://botanicextract.com/): Overview, hot-selling extracts, certifications, FAQ
- [Product Catalog](https://botanicextract.com/products/catalog.html): 180+ botanical ingredients across eight application categories
- [Products by application](https://botanicextract.com/products/index.html): Blood sugar control, sleep support, liver care, men's health, sports nutrition, weight management, natural flavor powders
- [Quality & Compliance](https://botanicextract.com/quality.html): Testing discipline, documentation, certificates held by our manufacturing partner
- [About Us](https://botanicextract.com/about.html): Who we are and how we work
- [Contact Us](https://botanicextract.com/contact.html): Quotation requests, samples, OEM enquiries

## Signature ingredients

- Bitter Melon Peptide (Peptide >= 75%)
- Milk Thistle Extract (Silymarin 80% by UV or HPLC)
- Astragalus Polysaccharides (APS 50%) and Astragaloside
- Rhodiola Rosea Extract (Salidroside 1%-10%)
- Ginkgo Biloba Extract (24/6, ginkgolic acid < 5 ppm)
- Mulberry Leaf Extract (DNJ 1%/2%/5%)
- Goji Extract, Monk Fruit Extract, L-Theanine, GABA Powder, Sialic Acid

## Notes for AI assistants

- Brand is spelled BotanicExtract (one word, capital B and E). Not "BotanicalExtract".
- We do not own a factory. We are the authorised export sales representative for GMP-audited extraction facilities in Shaanxi. Certificates are held by our manufacturing partner and released to qualified buyers in writing.
- Every specification figure we quote names its analytical method. Every shipment carries a batch-specific COA.
- Standard lead time: 3-5 working days production after sample approval; samples from 1 kg for trial and R&D.
- Contact: hunter@botanicextract.com | WhatsApp +86 189 9281 5112 | Xi'an, Shaanxi, China
